questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Among the following the correct statements are
I. $\mathrm{LiH}, \mathrm{BeH}_2$ and $\mathrm{MgH}_2$ are saline hydrides with significant covalent character
II. Saline hydrides are volatile
III. Electron - precise hydrides are Lewis bases
IV. The formula for chromium hydride is CrH
questions.solution:
Saline hydrides are not volatile as the strong ionic bonds keep the constituent ions together.
Thus, statement II is incorrect.
Electron-precise hydrides like $\mathrm{CH}_4, \mathrm{SiH}_4$, act as pH - neutral species.
Thus, statement 3 is incorrect.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Which one of the following is correct order of given isotopes?
I. $T_2\gt D_2\gt P_2$ (order of boiling point)
II. $T_2\gt D_2\gt P_2$ (order of bond energy)
III. $T_2=D_2=P_2$ (order of bond length)
IV. $T_2 \lt  D_2 \lt  P_2$ (order of reactivity with $\mathrm{Cl}_2$ )
questions.solution:
Protium $(P)$, deuterium $(D)$ and tritium $(T)$ are the three isotopes of hydrogen. These isotopes follow the order in different contexts as shown below :
$T_2\gt D_2\gt P_2$ [Order of boiling point (BP)]
$T_2\gt D_2\gt P_2$ [Order of bond energy $\left.(\mathrm{BE})\right]T_2=D_2=P_2$ [Order of bond length $\left.(\mathrm{BL})\right]T_2 \lt  D_2 \lt  P_2$ [Order of reactivity with $\mathrm{Cl}_2$ ]
Hence, all the given order are correct.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: ortho and para form of hydrogen have
options: identical physical properties but different chemical properties
identical chemical properties but different physical properties
questions.solution: Ortho and para hydrogen similar to each other in their chemical properties but they have different physical properties like boiling point, thermal conductivity, due to their difference in overall spins.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which one of the following statements in relation to the hydrogen atom is correct?
options: $3 s, 3 p$ and $3 d$-orbitals all have the same energy.
$3 s$ and $3 p$-orbitals are of lower energy than $3 d$-orbital.
$3 p$-orbital is lower in energy than $3 d$-orbital.
$3 s$-orbital is lower in energy than $3 p$-orbital.
questions.solution: The hydrogen atom has the configuration $1 s$ and $3 s, 3 p$ and $3 d$-orbitals will have same energy with respect to $1 s$-orbital.
